headline: Coastal is the honest call — Gibraltar needs a real jump
body:
Your season adds up to 165 miles across 13 rides, and the weekly line is spiky rather than building: 15.8, 10.1, 16.1, zero, then 65.6, and 17.5 so far this week. That 65.6-mile week shows what you can absorb, but it came from repeated short rides, not distance. On distance, your longest single ride is 17.9 miles — under a third of 62. On climbing, your best day is 736 ft over 3.6 miles, a fraction of Gibraltar's 2,551 ft in 6.1 miles. Today's training points to the 100 KM Coastal, and even that needs your long ride to roughly triple in the 45 days left.

This week: Wednesday and Thursday blow 15 mph with gusts to 24, so keep those short and easy. Friday and Saturday are calm and mild — make Friday your longest ride yet, Saturday a foothill climbing day. Sunday through Tuesday carry 25–38% rain; stay flexible and short.
